recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的漿細胞，偏心核、細胞質呈藍紫色且帶顆粒感，細胞質內有數個淡藍灰色、圓形、邊界清楚的球狀包涵體，不壓在核上，即 Russell bodies。
features: Plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus with coarse chromatin and abundant basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Three round, homogeneous, pale blue-gray globules in the cytoplasm (Russell bodies), separate from the nucleus
Adjacent plasmacytoid cell with oval nucleus and pale perinuclear cytoplasm
Background band neutrophils, myelocytes and small lymphocytes/erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus and abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing several round, homogeneous, pale blue-gray cytoplasmic globules consistent with Russell bodies. An adjacent plasmacytoid cell and background maturing granulocytes are present. Russell bodies represent distended rough endoplasmic reticulum filled with immunoglobulin; they can be seen in reactive and neoplastic plasma cells, so clonality should be assessed by light-chain studies.

ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies overlie or indent the nucleus as pseudo-intranuclear inclusions, whereas these globules are purely cytoplasmic.
A Mott cell is packed with numerous Russell bodies filling the cytoplasm, rather than the few globules seen here.
Vacuoles are optically empty, whereas Russell bodies are homogeneous, glassy and faintly stained.
